_about: The texture loop's five wear levels (docs/texture-loop). Each is a fixed E1 Age (years) and Care (0 neglected .. 1 kept), so every surface is judged at the same five points and the game can place any boat between them.

levels.name: Brand new
levels.look: mirror gelcoat, crisp non-skid, bright white rope, clean waterline, stiff white sails

levels.name: A few months
levels.look: faint tan scum line, scuffs where people step aboard and under the tiller, dust in the non-skid, rope a little soft

levels.name: Years in use (club boat)
levels.look: chalky topsides, grime trails on the foot paths, grey fuzzy rope, creased sails with tape repairs, tea stains, silver teak

levels.name: Decades old, maintained
levels.look: polished but faded and slightly yellow gelcoat, hairline crazing near fittings, off-white repairs, new rope on an old boat

levels.name: Neglected
levels.look: heavy chalk, black streaks under fittings, green slime at the waterline, mildew, white powder on aluminium, peeling varnish
